market.question: Will Crude Oil (CL) hit (HIGH) $120 by end of June?

assessment.reasoning: WTI ~$96-100 needs ~20% additional rally. EIA Brent peak forecast $115 = ~$110 WTI; $120 is above EIA central case but achievable given current escalation. Citi tail $150 Brent supports upside. With 2 months to go and Hormuz still closed, $120 is plausible.
assessment.key_uncertainty: How fast the supply disruption resolves and whether escalation widens
